lessons.statement: The `lint` skill tells the agent to run `npx eslint . --fix`, but this repository has no ESLint config or dependency, so following the skill is a guaranteed dead end and its 'fix the config' fallback invites out-of-scope work.

proposal.change: Remove the skill (or rewrite it to run the existing `npm test` command) until an ESLint config and dependency are added.

lessons.ask: Should this project get a real ESLint setup, or should the lint skill be deleted?
lessons.why: The skill loaded at [9], before any source edit, with instructions to run `npx eslint . --fix`. At [18] that command failed because no `eslint.config.*` exists. The agent then spent [20]–[23] re-checking the commit and re-reading the skill file, and at [30] reported the lint convention as unsatisfiable. package.json at [6] shows only a `test` script and no ESLint dependency.

lessons.statement: AGENTS.md requires `npm run build`, but package.json defines only a `test` script, so the mandated build check always fails and contributes nothing to verifying the change.

proposal.change: Remove the `npm run build` convention or replace it with the real check (`npm test` / `node --test test/`).

lessons.ask: Is a build step intended for this package, or should AGENTS.md drop it?
lessons.why: At [17] `npm run build` exited 1 with 'Missing script: build'. The package.json read at [6] defines only `test`. The agent had to mention the missing build pipeline in its final answer at [30].
